video_prompt: SOLO SHOT. One continuous front-camera phone video, the same framing from the first frame to the last. The same young man in a plain black t-shirt sits on the edge of his bed and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. The phone stays steady; the bedroom behind him stays still. He talks straight into the camera in a serious, confessional tone, with small natural head movements.
